items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The council is scheduled to hear an appeal of a previously approved permit for demolishing existing buildings at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street to build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space.

items.headline: Public scoping meeting for Oakmead Parkway housing project
items.summary: The city held a public meeting to gather input on the environmental review scope for a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway.
